wiki.title: Mary Margaret Oliver
wiki.extract: Mary Margaret Oliver (born March 7, 1948) is an American politician. She is a member of the Georgia House of Representatives from the 84th District, serving since 2003. She is a member of the Democratic Party. She previously served in the House from a special election in 1987 to 1993, and in the Georgia State Senate from 1993 to 1999. She ran for lieutenant governor in 1998, and led the initial primary but lost to fellow state senator Mark Taylor in a runoff.
